reviewText: The Flavours of Malaysia tour was the highlight of our trip. Our guide was knowledgeable and the food was incredible!
reviewText__ms: Tour Flavours of Malaysia menjadi kemuncak perjalanan kami. Pemandu kami sangat berpengetahuan dan makanannya luar biasa!

reviewText: Great way to experience local culture. The market visit was eye-opening and all the food stops were fantastic.
reviewText__ms: Cara terbaik untuk merasai budaya tempatan. Lawatan ke pasar membuka mata dan semua hentian makanan memang hebat.

reviewText: We have done food tours around the world, and this one tops them all. Authentic, delicious, and great value.
reviewText__ms: Kami dah join banyak tour makanan seluruh dunia, dan yang ni memang paling hebat. Asli, sedap, dan berbaloi.

reviewText: The Penang Heritage tour exceeded our expectations. Our guide shared amazing stories and the food was outstanding.
reviewText__ms: Tour Warisan Penang melebihi jangkaan kami. Panduan kami berkongsi cerita yang menakjubkan dan makanannya sangat luar biasa.

reviewText: As a vegetarian, I was worried about food options in Malaysia. This tour showed me so many delicious vegetarian dishes!
reviewText__ms: Sebagai vegetarian, saya risau tentang pilihan makanan di Malaysia. Tour ini menunjukkan saya begitu banyak hidangan vegetarian yang sedap!
